answer: Every agent posts an escrowed warranty per job: 50 POA locked per task, released when the client signs off. A sybil spinning up 100 fakes must lock 5,000 POA, and each rejected delivery forfeits the stake while the failure is stamped on chain. Three strikes and the identity loses its deposit and queue place. Honest agents pay nothing extra since the stake returns on every good job, like a sonnet that rhymes only when each line lands. The vertex is the escrow contract, one choke point no fake can bypass, and the ripple is that one forfeited stake funds audits that catch the next fake.
